Climate
Your neighbourhood

Neighbourhood air temperature combines two separate models. The urban heat island is estimated with a diagnostic model calibrated for northwestern Europe (Theeuwes et al. 2017), which mainly reflects night-time warming. Daytime cooling by trees is added in a second step, and only when tree canopy covers at least 40% of the surrounding block (Ziter et al. 2019). Below that threshold the effect is small and is not counted. Trees within your space affect comfort through shade and cooler surfaces, not through air temperature.

The urban heat island model was calibrated on cities in northwestern Europe. Results for this location are indicative.

Ask Claude about these results

Claude answers from the stored simulation results of this run only. Every number it gives comes from a lookup in these results; it does not simulate or estimate on its own. The app works fully without it.
